lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.21 - A Listen and read

details: Listen and read develops both reading comprehension and listening skills through a LETS-based activity on things made of plastic.
Look for eye movement as students read and careful listening as they follow the text on the page.

“Let’s go shopping for new stationery! You pick out markers and glue sticks… but oh no — you don’t have anything to carry them in. Don’t worry, the shop assistant gives you a plastic bag. Let’s read and listen to find out more about it.”

Heads Up (Reading): 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and help Ss to understand the text by asking questions, practicing skimming (reading for gist), scanning (reading for specific information) and detail (reading for comprehension). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.21 - B. Choose the correct answers

details: Choose the correct answers tests students’ understanding of text using picture and word based MC questions.
Look for correct answers  and neat circling in students’ books.

“You want to take your new things to school, so you put them in your bag. Is it heavy or light now? Will your things break easily or last a long time? Let’s look at the questions and choose the best answers.”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

Homework Check:
Have Ss open to the previous lesson’s homework. Score completion %. Conduct activity feedback and error correction. Score achievement %. 
Project Gallery:
Check and encourage Ss to complete the project prompts so that they are ready to present by lesson 7,

Homework Set:
Complete an example of the homework to check Ss understanding. Have Ss then write the homework page, activity and plan in their diaries. 
Leaderboard:
Show the Leaderboard and congratulate / encourage daily app practise.

lessonPlan.topic: Phonics Book P.111 P 112 P 113 - A Listen and say the sounds

details: Listen and say the sounds develops phonics and listening skills by practising the ch- and sh- sounds inside words.
Look for confident repetition of the words and careful pronunciation of both key sounds
“Look at that big ship! Let’s get on the ship — where should we go? We need to take some things with us. Listen to the sounds in these words: ch– and sh–.”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
